Maya (Product): Quick: FinReg needs an "audit evidence" quickwin — per-tenant cost tile + downloadable redacted trace sample. Scope MVP?
Ivy (Eng): Keep it tiny: estimated cost per-request (no token lineage) + stable 1% sampling. Redaction runs async before storage.
Noah (SRE): Hot index 7d, archive 60d. Default sampling 1% with tenant opt-in. Pipeline async, drop samples on lag.
Lina (Security): Redaction logs only (pattern IDs + counts). Exports signed and include redaction report. No raw PII stored.
Omar (CS): FinReg prefers CSV; will confirm fields. They want an attestable redaction proof.
Ivy (Eng): Pseudoconfig: 
```
audit_sample:
  mode: stable
  rate: 0.01
  hot_days: 7
```
Maya (Product): MVP cuts: 1) aggregated per-route cost tile, 2) sampled redacted traces export, 3) tenant opt-in pilot. Launch if pilot export + redaction report + perf check pass.
Noah (SRE): Perf guard: pipeline must not add >5ms p99 when async. Also produce cost estimate for storage.
Lina (Security): Add CI redaction tests and weekly verification job.
Maya (Product): Action items: Omar get FinReg schema (Thu), Ivy write brief design (Tue), UI-bot mock tile (Wed), Noah retention/cost numbers (Wed). Sync after docs.
UI-bot: Mock uploaded: /assets/mockups/audit-tile-v1.png :white_check_mark:
Maya (Product): Thanks — aiming Q2 pilot. Closing thread.
